_about: Public-domain Edward Harold Browne (1811-1891), Bishop of Ely and Winchester, for the Word Hoard: An Exposition of the Thirty-nine Articles (London: Parker, 1850) and Messiah as Foretold and Expected (1862), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 47 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

hbrowne-thirty-nine-articles: An exposition of the thirty-nine articles : historical and doctrical (London : John W. Parker, 1850)
hbrowne-messiah-foretold: Messiah as foretold and expected, a course of sermons (catalogued 1862)

_alternates.hbrowne-copies: Many later printings of the Exposition
_alternates.hbrowne-inspiration: The Inspiration of Holy Scripture (New York 1879): Browne's essay from Aids to Faith bound with a portion of an essay by Ellicott; two authors in one volume

_excluded.hbrowne-other: Aids to Faith (1862, many authors); examination question books on his Exposition by other hands
